Record SIP inflows hit ₹32,297 crore in August, small-cap funds draw ₹7,973 crore

The Association of Mutual Funds in India (AMFI) said total systematic investment plan (SIP) inflows reached ₹32,297 crore in August. This amount set a new record for monthly SIP inflows. The inflows occurred despite volatility in equity markets during the month. Small-cap mutual fund schemes received ₹7,973 crore of the total SIP amount. The strong small-cap inflow reflects heightened investor interest in that segment. The figures were reported by several Indian business news outlets.
